'''Fed-Dub Protective Services''' was an arm manufacturer during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It produced the [[Spukami pocket blaster pistol]] for inhabitants of the [[Double Worlds]], [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] and [[Tralus/Legends|Tralus]].
